notes: PVLAS 2015 polarimetry (vacuum magnetic birefringence/dichroism with 2.5 T rotating magnets and high-finesse Fabry-Perot cavity). New model-independent 95% CL laboratory exclusion for scalar and pseudoscalar ALPs in the (m, g) plane (Figure 14), spanning roughly 1e-4 to 1e-2 eV with g from ~7e-8 to ~1e-5 GeV^-1. No numerical table is given; the data points above are reconstructed from the paper's measured limits Delta_n = (-1.5±3.0)e-22 and Delta_kappa = (-1.6±3.5)e-22 at B=2.5 T using Eq. (5) (rotation/dichroism limit dominates below ~0.5-1 meV at ~7e-8 GeV^-1, matching the ALPS 2010 level as stated; ellipticity limit dominates above 1 meV, scaling roughly as g ∝ m at high mass reaching ~1e-6 GeV^-1 at 10 meV). Points are approximate figure-level values, hence reduced extraction confidence. Paper also sets milli-charged particle limits (epsilon vs mass), not covered by the coupling enum. Not a dark-matter haloscope, so no DM density assumption. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of the two PVLAS 2015 curves') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 33)) | Vision: Figure 14 of the PVLAS 2015 paper shows 95% c.l. exclusion limits for ALPs (both scalar and pseudoscalar); excluded region is above the curves. I traced the envelope of the two PVLAS 2015 curves: the blue 'Rotation PVLAS 2015' curve (flat at ~7.5e-8 GeV^-1 up to ~1 meV, then rising steeply with resonant oscillations) and the red 'Ellipticity PVLAS 2015' curve which dominates for m >= ~1.5 meV (minimum ~1.4e-7 GeV^-1 near 1.5 meV, rising to ~8e-7 at 10 meV). The OSQAR 2015 (black, ~4e-8 flat below 0.5 meV) and ALPS (brown) curves also appear but were not traced since the paper is PVLAS. Above ~2 meV the traced ellipticity curve is smooth; the rotation curve's oscillatory spikes above 1.5 meV lie above the ellipticity envelope.
